name: africa-ai-incident-observatory
title: Africa AI Incident Observatory
description: A source-traceable open research dataset documenting publicly evidenced AI incidents affecting African people, institutions and information environments, with explicit evidence confidence, provenance, multilingual discovery and operational-review layers.

sources.title: OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor methodology

resources.name: core-incidents
resources.description: Versioned core incident records that satisfy AAIO inclusion criteria.

resources.name: multilingual-evidence
resources.description: French-, Arabic- and Portuguese-language discovery records with translation provenance and uncertainty.

resources.name: operational-evidence
resources.description: Operational AI incident staging and promotion records with links to stable core IDs.

resources.name: watchlist
resources.description: Technology-governance cases intentionally excluded from the core dataset because AI attribution is not sufficiently established.

resources.name: record-history
resources.description: Append-only ledger for material record changes and promotion provenance.

_aaio.claim_boundary: Record counts reflect documented evidence visibility, not incident prevalence by country.
